Process

How a project runs

  1. Agree on the question

    A short chat about what you need to decide and which numbers matter.

  2. Clean the data

    I tidy your sheets, exports or CRM data so every figure adds up.

  3. Build the dashboard

    KPIs, trends and breakdowns on one clear page, in your tool of choice.

  4. Hand over

    You get the dashboard, a short summary of findings and one round of changes.
